verdict.rationale: Versioning and rolling back automations is a fair question for an API platform that hosts agents and prompts, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains nothing on versioning, reviewing, or rolling back a user's automations, agents, or prompts. The model deprecations page covers OpenAI's own model lifecycle, and evals test model outputs; both are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
